spec_match.rationale: Practical consequence of the removal: a same-origin widget's pagehide save is what the flag stops; replacements use only shipped APIs.

interactive.rationale: Editable seed field, real editable widget textarea, open + three close strategies, results table.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Blurb promises the legacy reliance and three replacements (handshake, mirroring, MutationObserver); handshake and mirror+observer are shown as B and C.

edge_cases.rationale: Idempotent flush prevents double saves; handshake wait is bounded at 500ms.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus, the HTML 'destroy a child navigable' algorithm and related Chromium sources.

conformance.rationale: Feature suite has 9 behavioural assertions mirroring the Blink web test; 8 fail and 1 (navigation-still-unloads) passes on Chrome 153 — every removal assertion can fail.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Chrome for Testing 153 headless via Playwright: A saved via pagehide (legacy), B via teardown message, C via pagehide + parent MutationObserver; typed text inside the widget was saved by B. Flag-on branch not executable here (flag absent in 153).

telemetry_health.rationale: Legacy observation and each replacement asserted separately; payloads hold counts only, never draft text.

design_system.rationale: Only design-system variables (--bg-*, --text-*, --accent-*) for colours; dark buttons use the global button rule, light secondary buttons set both background and color.

accessibility.rationale: Labelled input, native buttons in a labelled group, polite verdict, captioned table.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Desktop 1280x800 and mobile 360x740 DPR3 driven via Playwright: no page-level horizontal overflow, controls >=44px, console clean.

openQuestions.title: Verify the flag-on (156) branch in a real Chrome 156+/Canary
openQuestions.detail: Only Chrome for Testing 153 was available; OmitSubframeDetachmentEventsOnRemoval does not exist there (passing --enable-blink-features/--enable-features/experimental changed nothing). Re-run with --enable-blink-features=OmitSubframeDetachmentEventsOnRemoval and confirm the 'omitted' verdicts and telemetry asserts.

openQuestions.title: Inspect the accessibility tree with chrome-devtools-mcp
openQuestions.detail: chrome-devtools-mcp was not available in this environment (rule 7b); verification was headless Chrome via Playwright + screenshots, so names/roles were checked from DOM only.

guidanceConsulted.query: iframe teardown pagehide unload deprecation replacement
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Send telemetry with fetchLater() scheduled as data arrives rather than from unload-time handlers.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Cited as the telemetry replacement in the migration text; the demo itself persists user data via explicit handshake / parent-owned state instead (fetchLater would need a server endpoint).

guidanceConsulted.query: iframe teardown pagehide unload deprecation replacement
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Validate the source/origin of cross-document messages.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The widget only accepts the init message when e.source === parent, and all subsequent traffic goes over a private transferred MessagePort.

guidanceConsulted.query: event log live region status updates accessible
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use native buttons/inputs with visible labels and announce state changes via a polite status region.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Native buttons (min 44px), radio inputs wrapped in 44px labels, one role=status aria-live=polite verdict per experiment; logs are plain text.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive results table on narrow mobile viewport without page overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Keep header semantics (caption, th scope) and let wide tables scroll inside their own container instead of the page.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: .tablewrap has overflow-x:auto, tabindex=0, role=region with an aria-label naming the horizontal scroll; caption + th scope=col/row.

summary: Migration demo: replacements B and C save the draft without removal events; A's loss awaits a flag-on run.
